Loudred

Normal

Hoenn · Generation 3

Loudred is a Normal-type Big Voice Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 40.5 kg. It evolves from Whismur and into Exploud. Its highest base stat is HP (84), with a base stat total of 360.
